name: led
title: LED
description: A 6 pt lamp (4 small) in a small sunk socket, lit from the top left, that says one state by colour and gesture: green live, amber waiting, red failed, blue link, off a dull lens. The socket is its own ground on any surface; a lit lamp glows in its ink. Five gestures say how it behaves over time: steady, flicker, breathe, blink2, rise. Never alone; it sits beside words.
